description: Fix candidate status corruption bug that changes status to 'Project Assigned' after project assignment, causing authentication failures
steps: Fix assignProjectToCandidate() in backend/src/modules/candidate/candidate.service.js - remove conditional logic that always sets status to 'Project Assigned' and instead keep status as 'approved' while setting projectSubmissionStatus to 'not_started'
Fix updateCandidateProjectAssignment() in backend/src/modules/student/student.service.js - change status: 'Project Assigned' to status: 'approved'
Search for any other candidate.status = 'Project Assigned' or 'Project Completed' assignments using grep: 'grep -r "status.*=.*Project" backend/src/'
acceptance_criteria: After project assignment, candidate.status remains 'approved' (not 'Project Assigned')
Candidate can authenticate successfully after project assignment (requireVerifiedSession middleware allows access)
Project workflow is tracked in projectSubmissionStatus field instead of status field
verification: Run existing candidate tests: cd backend && npm test -- --testPathPattern=candidate
Manually test project assignment flow with a test candidate
Verify candidate.status === 'approved' after assignment in database
